1936, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 95 Feb. 29 Agnes H. O'Hearn, Albany N. York - Eyes
29 Cath Rochleau - 16 - see Feb. 2nd - now writes from Chicago - no address - seems to be getting on OK - working with little children.
Helen Johnson - 32 - Lymphatic lucemia - now in Eloise Hospital. Drs. say no cure. Enrolled about middle of last Novem. and for time quite improved ... Husband starts a perpetual membership.
Mrs. Maude Moreau ... close to 40 ....
Peter 0. LeDuc - 36 - of Toledo-seemingly paralysed -
1936, March
March Mar. Ist Joseph Gould - 28 - "infected eye, got piece of steel in eye Feb. 3rd. Drs. want to remove it - lest it infect good one. Enrolled To-day $1.00 - Has wife and three small ch'n
3rd More hopeful To-day. .. March 6 phones, "very hopeful" - March 12th comes seeing - hopeful man. Deo G.
3rd Maria Yearsky - 30 - has 4 children dying of cancer. Cha's Horger - 57 - cancer of liver
Page 96 Mar. 3 Wm. Shanahan - Mt. Pleasant - 41 - T.B. very low Daniel Shanahan - Gr. Rapids - 86 - very sick
Kath Franckowiak - 74 - out of her mind now two weeks ... Very pecu- liar .... Cursed a number of people - relatives ... that they choke & not be able to die. Now seems to be in exactly insane. Her daughter too - whom she cursed suffer in
Mrs. Eliz Haddas - 43 - fearful asthma - has husband and five small children ... Rev. Fr. Walsh of Assumption ... anointed last night Cetnar Children ... Losing the faith
Page 97 March 10 Joseph Filarski - 44 - Sadly indifferent to needs of wife and 7 children- prospers all for self.
